citation: Menota AM-132-fol-Njals-saga 54r:1; wave-7 report 2, observation 0. Legal invitation to challenge a jury; Kaikki separates verdict/inquest *kwidiz from belly *kweþuz. The reported 53v:42 is displaced; matching invitation is at 54r:1.
Menota AM-162-B-fol-theta 2r:16; wave-7 report 17, observation 0. Place of origin of king Guðröðr after ór. Kaikki Mǫn is the Isle of Man, borrowed from Old Irish; not modal munu.
Menota AM-36-fol 143:; wave-7 report 17, observation 1. Accusative human object qualified by a relative naming Sveinn. Source locus is 143, not 142; Kaikki maðr has accusative mann.
Menota AM-56-4to 20v:14; wave-7 report 17, observation 2. Human object of wounding by a mad man. Source is 20v:14; Kaikki maðr accusative mann, not munu.
Menota AM-56-4to 18r:13; wave-7 report 17, observation 3. Rank-qualified person appointed from the retinue; source 18r:13, Kaikki maðr accusative mann.
Menota AM-56-4to 76v:6; wave-7 report 17, observation 6. Same killing clause at 76v:6 as observation 4; current loader still infers modal munu.
Menota AM-56-4to 20r:3; wave-7 report 17, observation 5. Outlawed human object of sheltering at 20r:3; Kaikki maðr accusative mann.

Menota AM-162-B-fol-theta 1v:8; wave-7 report 18, observation 0. Source names Gunnarr’s brother alongside Kolskeggr; a second occurrence recalls his death. Inferred NP is correct, but the inherited deer homograph passes the exact-lexeme gate, so these personal-name occurrences need explicit reviewed exceptions.

Menota AM-35-fol 123:; wave-7 report 20, observation 0. Season coordinated with autumn and winter after um; the corpus already has a reviewed spring sense distinct from vera.
Menota AM-35-fol 123:; wave-7 report 21, observation 0. Dative personal name immediately before the title jarl. The form-table winner is halla/VB, so NP propagation alone cannot repair it.

Menota AM-36-fol 143:; wave-7 report 22, observation 0. The first token names the man via heita; the following dual construction refers to Sveinn and his companion. Kaikki Sveinn is a personal name; inferred common-noun tag is wrong.

Menota AM-56-4to 58v:5; wave-7 report 27, observation 0. Source fishing-place noun after veiði, including two adjacent legal provisions. Kaikki stǫð is place/berth from standa; retain only the stand root, not the finite verb lexeme.

Menota AM-36-fol 332:16; wave-7 report 30, observation 0. Neuter adjective modifying orð in dialogue. Kaikki mjúkr soft/meek < *meukaz; its existing untie-root mapping is unsupported and removed rather than adding a false etymon.
Menota AM-36-fol 332:13; wave-7 report 33, observation 0. Accusative journey after um with possessive þina; Kaikki fǫr journey, not finite fara.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 19v:20; wave-7 report 33, observation 3. Same former-journey clause as observation 2; retain travel root through reviewed noun sense.

Menota AM-36-fol 386:23; wave-7 report 34, observation 0. Both source verse occurrences refer to a feeding raven; inferred NP needs a reviewed common-noun exception. Kaikki *hrabnaz discusses sound-symbolic *krobʰ-, not growth; remove the grow mapping, without asserting a disputed replacement.

Menota DG-8-OHleg 0003:4; wave-7 report 37, observation 0. Source AJ predication with grief after difficult childbirth. Kaikki separates sorrowful adjective from backbone noun; no secure replacement PIE equation asserted.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 5v:12; wave-7 report 42, observation 0. Long waiting before Knútr attends the service; Kaikki bíða wait with participle beðinn, distinct from biðja ask.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 5v:8; wave-7 report 43, observation 0. Habitual late rising with infinitival complement; Kaikki separates accustomed *wenh₁- from lacking *h₁weh₂-.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 27v:30; wave-7 report 43, observation 1. Praying as he was often accustomed. Source 27v:30; same dictionary homograph distinction.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 0100:5; wave-7 report 43, observation 2. Dogs accustomed to tracking people; source 0100:5, same accustomed adjective.

Menota DG-8-OHleg 5v:22; wave-7 report 44, observation 0. The paired law clauses oppose serving law to having God’s laws serve him. Norwegian love is the law noun, not praise; Kaikki lǫg provides the legal lexeme.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 0020:5; wave-7 report 45, observation 0. Grímkell accompanies the king on a journey, source 0020:5. Kaikki fǫr, not for furrow; report’s pig gloss also misdescribes stored pérḱs.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 18r:13; wave-7 report 55, observation 0. Sigurðr’s byname identifies the deceased stepfather; source 18r:13 has NC, so the NP rule cannot repair it.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 0024:36; wave-7 report 55, observation 1. Sigurðr’s byname in the expedition narrative; source 0024:36 has NC, requiring a contextual exception to the sow homograph.
Menota AM-36-fol 247:; wave-7 report 61, observation 0. Dative adjective modifying light; source 247, not 245. Kaikki mikill great; diplomatic miclo corresponds to miklu.
Menota AM-36-fol 247:; wave-7 report 62, observation 0. The farmers look toward the sun; source 247. Kaikki líta lists past plural litu.
Menota AM-36-fol 247:; wave-7 report 63, observation 0. Genitive definite sun after til in the same source clause; Kaikki sól lists sólar and definite paradigm.
Menota DG-8-OHleg 22v:7; wave-7 report 75, observation 0. The man is killed in the sword exchange. Kaikki distinguishes slay *wiganą/*weyk- from carry *weganą/*weǵʰ-.

Menota DG-8-OHleg 0070:35; wave-7 report 83, observation 0. People meet the king and reconcile with him; Cleasby–Vigfusson s.v. sætta (https://oldnorsedictionary.com/home/word/s%C3%A6tta) derives the verb from sátt. Reuse reviewed reconcile sense, not sweet.

Menota DG-8-OHleg 0084:29; wave-7 report 85, observation 0. The king’s followers urge on fighting. Report’s suggested liðr is also inaccurate: Faulkes, Edda Skáldskaparmál glossary s.v. liði (https://vsnr.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/VSNR_Edda-2b_skaldskaparmal_2.pdf) identifies follower; isolate without the slope or limb mapping.

Menota DG-8-OHleg 35v:24; wave-7 report 94, observation 0. Infinitives obey with words/king as dative objects. Kaikki hlýða < *hliuþijaną < *ḱlew-; source lacks initial h. Only reviewed loci, since other lýða tokens may mean fare/allow.
